description.value: The Sunshine Coast Museum & Archives is a community-driven heritage institution in the heart of Gibsons Landing, about 10 minutes from the BC Ferries terminal at Langdale. Spread across two floors, it presents exhibits on First Nations history, early logging, marine transportation, beachcomber relics, and over 9,000 archival photographs and documents. A touring cyclist coming off the ferry will find it a compelling introduction to the region's layered history, with a gift shop and virtual museum resources as well.
